verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Kong AI Gateway can proxy, govern and generate MCP servers for customers' own APIs (the AI MCP Server entity and the AI MCP Proxy plugin). That is a building block for constructing MCP servers, not an official first-party MCP server that lets an agent connect to and operate Kong AI Gateway itself. The pack has no evidence of such an official Kong MCP server or hosted endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
